name: IntuneShade
description: IntuneShade is a free community console for Microsoft Intune admins that lets you sign in with a Microsoft 365 account to view and manage your tenant—assignments, device compliance, Autopilot, and reports—without any install or app registration. This multi-tenant SPA runs in the browser with delegated Graph permissions and no server-side data storage. Key features include Group Assignment Manager, Bulk Assign, AI policy analysis and script generation, conflict detection, smart bulk automation, assignment matrix, compliance reporting, and audit history.
author: Alper Atar

securityCheck.aiSummary: Security review completed. No hardcoded API keys detected, and SSRF protections for Azure OpenAI endpoints are in place. However there is a significant data exfiltration risk due to sending tenant policy data to external LLM providers, and a potential risk around generated scripts that could be misused to perform remote code execution on endpoints. Additionally, a hard-coded public client ID is present (not a secret) and should be managed via configuration rather than embedded in code.

noDataExfiltration.reason: The tool sends policy data and other user-provided content to external AI providers (Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini) for analysis, scripting, resolution, and compliance workflows. This constitutes data exfiltration risk for tenant data. Mitigations: implement data handling controls, redact sensitive information before sending to third parties, consider on-premises or enterprise LLM options, add opt-in/opt-out controls, and ensure transmission is governed by data processing agreements.
